title: Quick Korean Uni Tteokguk
description: A yeasty, cheese-pull, hangover-cure Korean Busan dish featuring uni and sous-vide eggs-free method in form of guk.
instructions: Place the tteok in a large pot and cover with water.
Bring to a boil and cook for 10 minutes or until the tteok is tender.
While the tteok is cooking, combine the soy sauce, brown sugar, ginger, garlic, and chili paste in a blender and blend until smooth.
Heat the sesame oil in a pan over medium heat and add the blended soy sauce mixture.
Cook for 2 minutes or until the mixture thickens and turns dark brown.
Add the cooked tteok to the pan and stir to coat with the soy sauce mixture.
Add the uni and stir to combine.
Using a slotted spoon, place the uni and tteok mixture into individual bowls.
Top each bowl with a sous vide egg yolk and a sprinkle of cheese.
Place the bowls under the broiler for 2-3 minutes or until the cheese is melted and bubbly.
Garnish with green onions and serve hot.
